description: This header file declares functions for loading and rendering 3D models in a Lua scripting environment, specifically supporting OBJ files. It includes documentation comments with usage examples.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads a 3D model from a file, supporting OBJ format, into the Lua environment.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Renders a previously loaded 3D model within the Lua scripting environment.
